mapper.select: SELECT vehicle_id, status, battery, position_x, position_y, heading, speed, message_at, received_at, updated_at FROM vehicle_current_status WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_current_status (vehicle_id, status, battery, position_x, position_y, heading, speed, message_at, received_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{status}, #{battery}, #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{heading}, #{speed}, #{messageAt}, #{receivedAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), battery = VALUES(battery), position_x = VALUES(position_x), position_y = VALUES(position_y), heading = VALUES(heading), speed = VALUES(speed), message_at = VALUES(message_at), received_at = VALUES(received_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(s.status, 'UNKNOWN') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN vehicle_current_status s ON v.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id WHERE v.active = true GROUP BY COALESCE(s.status, 'UNKNOWN')
